lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: Commander,

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: I just emailed you the stuff you asked for.

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: There might be loads of unfamiliar jargon,

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: so I suggest taking your time to go through it carefully.
That was fast. Thank you.

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: Well, color me surprised!

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: I didn't think that you'd be into politics.
That's not quite what I'm doing.

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: True that.

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: You'd much rather soar in ranks within Ark through your achievements alone.

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: But it might be a good idea to check out the stuff I sent you.

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: After all, we wouldn't want you getting tricked, right?

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: There once was a commander who rose through the ranks in the same way you hope to.

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: I never met him personally,

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: but apparently he was a remarkable individual.

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: However, he fell so tragically and disappointingly.

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: He was clueless about how politics worked.

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: He couldn't quite catch onto all the hidden meanings in what people said,

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: or figure out why certain talks were more than meets the eye,

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: and it eventually led to his downfall.
Is there...

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: Hmm?
Is there any chance you could tell me who he was?

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: Huh? Why?
Because I think I may know who you're referring to.

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: It's probably who you're thinking of.

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: Good luck, and may you not suffer the same fate as him, Commander.
Got it, thanks.

lines.speaker: shifty
lines.text: You always have my support.
